subQuests.subQuestName: Report your recent progress to Dopey Dazzler

755040102.text: Judging by your looks, I assume you've seen some spots, gathered some materials, and found your inspiration?

755040103.text: Well... sorta? We certainly had fun along the way!

755040104.text: Having a specific goal in mind helped us notice lots of details we wouldn't have before...

755040105.text: This material-gathering project's been a real eye-opener for us, and we've come away with lots of samples too!

755040108.text: Oh, take your time, no rush! The whole point of the tour around Natlan was to help you realize what "avant-garde" is in the first place.

755040109.text: Speaking of which, mind telling me what you've seen and heard?

755040110.text: You show Dopey Dazzler the graffiti guidebook and the various photos you've taken...

755040111.text: Hmm... Well. Aren't you the conscious photo-taker?

755040112.text: I didn't expect you to be so experienced with Kameras as to subconsciously select excellent compositions for all these pictures.

755040113.text: If anything, there's a danger I'll be stunting your growth if I say too much. Just a little guidance is all you'll need.

755040114.text: Please, take these notes of mine. Just give them a quick flick through when you encounter scenery on your journey. Perhaps they'll help you take pictures of even greater artistry!

755040115.text: Huh. And here Paimon thought we'd be treated to a picture-by-picture analysis and... Y'know, avant-garde introductory lectures!

755040116.text: Paimon's also tempted to try doing some graffiti herself...

755040117.text: All the more reason to think that you're talented enough for self-driven learning!

755040118.text: If anything, too much by-the-books learning might snuff that sort of potential out.

755040119.text: As such, I think I need to adjust my role from responsible mentor to an assisting senior artist.

755040120.text: Just wait for a rush of inspiration at the opportune moment, then pick your paint jar up and show the world what you've got!

755040121.text: Huh. We're that talented, are we?

755040122.text: Hehe... Looks like all the commissions we took from painters and film directors haven't gone to waste!
